title: Race day
notes: Tiles are 128x128 on a 128 px grid. Road: road_v (vertical straight), road_h (horizontal straight), corners named by the two sides they open to: road_se (south+east, like a top-left corner of a loop), road_sw (south+west, top-right), road_ne (north+east, bottom-left), road_nw (north+west, bottom-right). finish_v / finish_h are straights with the checkered line. Off-road: grass, grass2 (plain grass, tile them everywhere). Cars point UP (north) at 0 rotation, 71x131 px: car_red_1, car_blue_1, car_green_1, car_yellow_1, car_black_1 (sporty) and car_*_3 (other body); scale to ~0.5 on the 128 grid. Props: tires_red / tires_white (56 px stacks), cone_straight, barrier_red_race / barrier_white_race (210x62), tree_small / tree_large (about 200 px canopy), tribune_full (grandstand 448x223), tent_red / tent_blue, oil (slippery patch), arrow_white, skidmark_short_1, lights (start lights). Sounds: bump (crash), select (countdown beep), coin (lap), magic (finish), hurt.
